build_AllScAIP_backbone: build an AllScAIP backbone model with graph attention blocks and configurable transformer layers for molecular property prediction
create_AllScAIP_energy_head: create an AllScAIP energy head that predicts molecular energy using a feedforward network with compilable scatter reduction
create_AllScAIP_direct_force_head: create an AllScAIP direct force head that predicts atomic forces using a feedforward network on node representations
create_AllScAIP_gradient_energy_force_st: create an AllScAIP gradient-based head that computes energy, forces, and stress via autograd on energy output
review_AllScAIPBackbone_validate_atoms_d: review the AllScAIPBackbone validate_atoms_data method that sets and validates charge and spin defaults for ASE atoms input
